title: Love the phone game, def gonna use the one for Mac too!
body:
I would love to connect my Facebook account so I can sync with my Phone, right now I could only do via Apple. 

I'm ALWAYS using the phone app! Waiting for new features. But a good MVP!
author: dra åt

title: Super cute and rewards focus
body: I have found it really helpful to have the calm timer on (I especially appreciate the Pomodoro timer!), and having cute things to plant and water helps to ensure that I take short breaks as I study so I don’t burn out. I have just small suggestions for improvement: 1) that a timed 20-25 minute break would be included after the 4 Pomodoro sessions and 2) that the free white noise would be anything but the ticking clock!

title: Varför Focusplant är bäst
